derivation: or זִלְעָפָהxlit zilʻâphâph corrected to zilʻâphâh; from H2196 (זָעַף);
def: a glow (of wind or anger); also a famine (as consuming)

occurrences.text: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.
Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.
Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
